ch.07.label: jumat 06 nov 09:00 ch.07
ch.07.caption:
my pinterest has 200 saves and 0 actions.

that's not a moodboard. that's a graveyard i keep feeding.

saving is how i feel productive without changing anything. the folder gets fuller, the life stays the same.

ch.08.label: jumat 06 nov 13:00 ch.08
ch.08.caption:
the only prompt that ever got me out of pinterest:

"turn this save into 1 tiny thing i can do in 10 mins with what i already own."

"soft morning desk" → coffee without the phone, nothing else open.
"sunday reset" → wipe the counter. that counted. 🕯️

ch.09.label: jumat 06 nov 20:30 ch.09
ch.09.caption:
every sunday i ask AI one question:

"what did i do this week that i don't remember doing?"

it's been brutal. and it's the most useful 5 minutes of my week.

the things i forget are never the big ones. it's the small loops i ran 40 times.

ch.10.label: sabtu 07 nov 09:00 ch.10
ch.10.caption:
AI can write your essay, plan your week, rebuild your resume.

it can't tell you what to wear. because it doesn't know you own 7 black shirts and will still feel weird in all 7.

context beats model. every time.

ch.11.label: sabtu 07 nov 13:00 ch.11
ch.11.caption:
the 5 lines i paste at the start of every new chat:

who i am
what i do all day
what i repeat every week
where i get stuck
what i avoid

that's it. you're not prompting a stranger anymore. 🧸

ch.12.label: sabtu 07 nov 20:30 ch.12
ch.12.caption:
closing the laptop doesn't close the simulation.

i noticed it at 1am. nothing open, nothing on screen, and my brain was still running the same loop it was on at 11am.

there is no off-ramp. so i built one. 20 minutes, no screens, same time every night. it's the only reason i sleep. 🌙

what's your off-ramp? i'm collecting them.
